title: Unit Event — Star of Your Own Story — Episode6 Imagination Rediscovered

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime have decided to work with other troupes, starting with the long-established Shunmeiza. Given a minor role with just three lines, Tsukasa faces a seemingly impossible task: to convince the director that his character is a real person.

rows.Line: Park Cafe

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You needed someone to talk to...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait...
What does people-watching have to do with wanting to talk with someone?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Oh, umm...
It's actually a very long story...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't care! I'm willing to listen!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Then, I'll try to give you the short version.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Like I said just now, I started people-watching back when I was in elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Back then, I was a little lonely...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Lonely?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Yes. My parents didn't get along well...
They also both worked, and I found myself at home alone most of the time.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: As you can probably tell, I'm pretty introverted, which led to me having no friends...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
I almost never talked to anyone.
So...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: In order to remedy my loneliness, I started making up people for me to talk to.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Making up...people...?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Yes.
I first thought it'd be good to talk to characters from stories, so I started with books...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: From Sindbad to Alice, I talked to so many people...and even to some characters who weren't people.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: They were all just a part of my imagination...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
But I had fun talking to them...
A lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I began thinking about the people passing me by on the street...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Then, I started writing in my notebook about people's lives and how they might be interesting.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
And so, that's why...
I need this in order to talk to other people.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I never would've guessed...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Bakuno's desire to talk to someone led to him spending years and years coming up with stories about the lives of countless others—regardless of whether or not they were true.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That sort of imagination is what allows him to make his characters feel so real...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However, does that mean...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (There is no quick solution to this problem of mine?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I came up with a story for my character the way Bakuno has for his, then I might be able to gain a better understanding.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However, Bakuno's imagination is the product of the difficulties he's faced since his childhood.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (With my imagination, I may not be able to come up with much of a backstory for Nakayama...)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh, I'm so sorry... I didn't mean to talk for so long...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, um...! That's not what I was thinking!
It's just... I see how this notebook allows you to play such convincing characters.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is why you're able to put on such incredible performances. This is how you make all the characters you play shine.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I make them shine...?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I've...always identified with supporting characters...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Any play or show with more than one character must have supporting roles. Even so, the audience will focus their attention on the protagonist and other main characters instead of them...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: There's nothing anyone can do about that, but I always see myself in them whenever I think about them...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
No one pays attention to them...
Like my childhood self.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bakuno...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: They make me want to shine a light on them through my acting.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: My desire to have others see that supporting characters are also people with their own rich lives had led to me only playing them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
And that's why for this play, you're playing...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: But I've been receiving more and more offers to play leading characters, including for movies and such...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, you've been asked to play the lead in movies?! That's incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Yes.
But, as happy as I am about receiving such offers...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I can't take my mind off “them”.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Which is why I've been turning down those offers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As an actor, I can't help but envy him, and I wish I could see him in a lead role on the big screen... But there's nothing that can be done if those are his wishes...)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
We're getting a little sidetracked.
Anyway, I hope what I said helped...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, yes!
Very much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Bakuno.
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've tried thinking about this a thousand different ways.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I'm going to get even a step closer to Bakuno's level... I just don't have the imagination.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I may be an actor, but I've never really imagined someone else's life before.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Or rather...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I only thought about making those around me smile.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was my original motivation, and nothing can change that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I should have trained myself to be more imaginative to have any hope of becoming a star.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, what's important is where I go from here. I'll start reading more books, people-watching and improving my imagination to become more like Bakuno in due time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However... I still don't have a solution to my current problem.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I can figure out a “story” for my character the way Bakuno has for his, then I might be able to gain a somewhat better understanding.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That being said, with my poor imagination, I won't be able to get very far with Nakayama... At least, that's how I feel at the moment.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now now, I can't just give up before even trying.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I know. At times like this, I should...
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No matter what time I visit, this place is still beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So beautiful that I'm already starting to feel much better!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, it is pretty late.
I don't see Miku and the others anywhere. They may be aslee—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? What's that?
It sounds like a car...
Tsukasa! You came at a good time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That voice... Wahhh!!!!!!
se_event_supporting_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: M-MEIKO, what in the world is that thing?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This? It's a three-wheel truck, silly.
I'm sure you're aware that there were many of these zooming around during the Showa period.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, that's not what I'm asking...!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
Tsukasa!
Good evening!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, you're also here!
I couldn't see you in her shadow.

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
This three-wheel truck's so much fun!
You should join us, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'll pass...
But where did this thing even come from?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The play you're preparing for takes place during the Showa period, yes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We decided to also do a show that takes place during that time in the hopes that we'd get a better understanding of what things were like back then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, we took some spare parts that were lying around to build what we needed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-You built this...?! How...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be fair, this SEKAI has a flying train in it, so I guess it's not out of the realm of possibility.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But in any case, I'm glad you're all enjoying yourselves. Seeing that me feel better.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hm? Wait, Tsukasa.
Does that mean you weren't feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I wasn't unwell or anything...
But I've been having trouble dealing with this and that.

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Then, we should do a show together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
H-Huh?!
Why now all of a sudden?!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Because you look a little down...

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Remember how you came up with those shows for us? They were called “Bunny's Big Adventures”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Bunny's...
Ah, yes. I do remember.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Bunny's Big Adventures”?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: He came up with a load of stories with me as the star! I was so happy!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Really?! You were the star?!
Can you tell me more about those stories?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
They were tales full of action and excitement!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our heroes sail across the sea, weigh anchor at an island inhabited by monsters, find treasure—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Treasure...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I came up with those stories on the spot with our friend here as the protagonist.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They pale in comparison to Bakuno's stories in both quality and quantity...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I came up with it in a manner similar to how he people-watches.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And I was able to do that because... Because I was thinking about the bunny's life... About the bunny as the star of the story...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's it!
I just have to think about him as if he's the star!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was so focused on making my character fit the plot and the time period.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that alone wasn't enough to get him to feel like a real human being.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've been seeing Nakayama as an insignificant character, like a simple plot device or part of the scenery.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But I see my folly now.
Side characters are people in their own right with lives of their own. Nakayama is the star of his own story.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That changes everything, even when he says, “Morning.” That word is but a small excerpt from the tale of Nakayama.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means I just need to come up with a story where he's the star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Instead of just a supporting character with only three lines, I should be thinking of him as the protagonist of a separate tale...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I may be able to flesh him out in fine detail the way Bakuno does...! I'm going to get started on this right away!!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Umm... I'm not entirely sure what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Did I help?
